title: TropiNord Tea Collection
subtitle: Explore our selection of black, green, fruit and herbal blends sourced from trusted growers and refined with care. Every doypack includes loose tea and eco-friendly teabags so you can craft your own perfect brew at home. Premium blends. Personal preparation. Pure experience.

safety.heading: Important notice
safety.herbal: For food safety reasons, always use boiling water and brew for at least 5 minutes.
safety.fruit: For food safety reasons, always use boiling water and brew for at least 5 minutes.
safety.green: Use water below boiling to preserve delicate flavors. Contains natural caffeine.
safety.white: Use water below boiling to preserve delicate flavors. Contains natural caffeine.
